notes: NvidiaToken (src/NvidiaToken.sol) is a fixed-supply ERC-20 built on OpenZeppelin v5 ERC20 with a transfer tax. The constructor takes the launch factory ($factory), the Uniswap v4 PoolManager ($poolManager) and this launch's number ($launchNumber, uint64), reverts with ZeroAddress() if either address is zero, makes no external call, and mints the whole supply of 1,000,000,000 ADVN (1000000000000000000000000000 minor units, 18 decimals) once to msg.sender, the factory. Nothing can mint afterwards. There is no owner, pauser, blacklist, fee setter, minter or upgrade path. Every taxed transfer is split three ways in _update: 0.5% (TRIBUTE_BPS = 50) goes to Jensen Huang's wallet 0xc59b0c072f73ceea3dc354031165501c0ff25023 (a constant), 1% (BURN_BPS = 100) is burned from totalSupply, and the receiver gets the remaining 98.5%; each cut rounds down. Untaxed launch flows: transfers from or to the factory; transfers from or to the launch's MerkleDistributor (read from the factory with distributorOf(launchNumber) via a gas-capped staticcall at transfer time, then cached; any failed or malformed answer reads as not known yet); and transfers into the PoolManager. So the swarm's share, claims, the pool seed and every sell into the PoolManager arrive exactly. Mints and burns are exact. Transfers out of the PoolManager (pool buys, liquidity withdrawals, take) are taxed like any other transfer: the whole tax comes out of the PoolManager's balance and the receiver gets 98.5%, which also closes the sync/settle/take escrow route around the tax. Wallet-to-wallet transfers and other venues pay the tax. The README records two readings for the requester to confirm: "every trade" as every non-launch-flow transfer, and the burn as 1% of the transferred amount. No application contracts are deployed and no initialization calls are made. The token's runtime contains no DELEGATECALL, CALLCODE or SELFDESTRUCT.
